messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service 'infra-ops' (svc-00711) — check 'inference-http-5xx-rate' exceeded threshold in eu-central-1. Incident: INC1799999999. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC1799999999

vik: acked on PD. i'm on infra-ops today but this looks inference-specific. starting quick triage.

dana: i just got woken up by infra-ops page, not on inference rota. appears ~8% of hosted inference requests 5xx in eu-central.

sre-rotation-bot: note: dana is not listed on inference-oncall. Current inference primary is @vik-inference (vik).

vik: running `curl -v https://api.eu-central.redwood.ai/v1/generate` — intermittent 503s, stacktrace shows model worker eviction. grabbing logs: `kubectl -n inference-prod get pods -l app=inference -o wide` then `kubectl logs`

vik: ```
WARN proc: kv-cache eviction threshold breached
ERROR model-server: failed to fetch weights: disk i/o timeout
ERROR http: upstream returned 503
```

support-lead: why did PD target infra-ops? alert rule has label `team:infra` in the alertmanager template now. we rolled a change earlier that updated common labels. prob the PD mapping keys off that.

dana: confirmed in alert rule: selector includes `team=infra` and `service=inference` (confusing). PD routing priority takes `team` first so infra-ops got the page.

oncall-manager: mitigation steps: 1) reassign incident to inference-oncall 2) silence infra-ops service to stop further wakeups 3) short scale + restart of inference runtime pods 4) revert template change + CI assertion. who can run the pd reroute/silence?

vik: i'm running pdcli now: `pdcli incidents reroute --incident INC1799999999 --to inference-oncall --reason "alert label drift"`

pd-cli-bot: pdcli: Incident INC1799999999 reassigned to inference-oncall. New assignee: dana.

dana: taking primary. executing maintenance: `pdcli maintenance create --service infra-ops --duration 45m --reason "misrouted inference alerts"`

pd-cli-bot: maintenance created for infra-ops (45m).

dana: scaling inference runtime: `kubectl -n inference-prod scale deploy/inference-runtime --replicas=14` and rolling restart of `inference-model-worker` to flush stuck shards.

vik: monitoring: error spike drops after restart. request 5xx rate down from 8% -> 1.2% in eu-central over 7m.

support-lead: customer impact: approx 120 customers saw degraded requests during window, estimated SLO blip for ~10 minutes. raising support notification.

dana: root cause short: a templated alert label change in repo infra/alert-templates replaced `team: inference` with `team: infra` for common selector during yesterday's rollout. PD mapping uses `team` label -> wrong service.

oncall-manager: action items: - revert template change (PR queued) - add a PD-mapping lint to CI that ensures `team` label maps to PD service - document pdcli reroute steps in runbook - run a drill next week to simulate misroute and reroute flow.

vik: created PR to revert and added a test: `assert(alert.labels.team in PD_TEAM_MAP)` in pipeline.

dana: filed incident impact note and set severity. link: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/INC1799999999/notes

sre-rotation-bot: oncall update: dana primary for remainder of shift. vik standby. Please follow handoff checklist after incident close.

support-lead: closing notes: PD incident will be resolved once metrics stable for 15m and template reverted. proceeding to rollback now.

pd-cli-bot: PagerDuty: INC1799999999 resolved by dana at 2026-03-02T03:30:00Z

dana: will draft a short postmortem and add CI lint + runbook link. also scheduling a 10-min oncall drill to test reroute next Tuesday.

vik: thanks all for quick triage. main takeaway: be careful with templated common labels, they can silently change PD routing.
